info.title: DrainSense
info.description:
Global flood desk API. Two separate models are served here.

* **Risk map** (`/risk`, `/sectors`, `/response`): logistic flood-susceptibility scores for 5-degree cells,
  from `model/train.py`.
* **Flood impact** (`/impact`): the CatBoost regressor from the executive brief, from `model/impact.py`.
  Its target is the DFO magnitude, log10(days × severity × area_km2). When those three are known the
  formula is exact, and every prediction returns it next to the model's estimate. Weather inputs are
  Open-Meteo (ERA5 / ERA5-Land) daily values at the centre of the flooded area. Read
  `GET /api/v1/impact/model` before using the numbers.

Drainage reports, inspections, repairs and incidents shipped with the app are synthetic drill rows.

`end_date`, `area_km2` and `severity` are all sent. Required fields per variant are listed
under `inputs` in `GET /api/v1/impact/model`.

get.description:
Every cell scored for every label year, 2014 to the outlook, beside the DFO label where one exists.

`cells[cell_id].probability[i]` and `.flooded[i]` line up with `years[i]`. `flooded` is null in the
outlook year. `summary` gives, per year, the cells at or above the threshold, the recorded flood cells,
hits, misses, false alarms and ROC-AUC.

Regions likely to be affected by flooding between today and `until`, at most two weeks ahead.

Combines each cell's risk-model score with Open-Meteo's daily rainfall forecast at the cell centre, by the
published rule in `rule`. Levels: `likely`, `watch`, `quiet`; cells come most at risk first. A date before
today or more than 14 days ahead is refused with 422.

schema.description: Last day of the window, YYYY-MM-DD: today (UTC) to 14 days ahead. Default: 14 days ahead.
